# Function to download csv from azure blob storage
# Returns the downloaded file name
def azure_download_csv_to_df(downloaded_file_name):
    url = F'https://chiknstorageaccount.blob.core.windows.net/chiknyooz/{downloaded_file_name}'
    connection_string = AZURE_CHIKN_YOOZ_CONNECTION_STRING
    blob_service_client = BlobServiceClient.from_connection_string(connection_string)
    path = urlparse(url).path
    path = path.split("/")
    container = path[1]
    blob = '/'.join(path[2:])
    blob_client = blob_service_client.get_blob_client(container=container, blob=blob)
    with BytesIO() as input_blob:
        blob_client.download_blob().download_to_stream(input_blob)
        input_blob.seek(0)
        df = pd.read_csv(input_blob)
        df.to_csv(downloaded_file_name, sep='\t', encoding='utf-8-sig', index=False, header=False)
    return downloaded_file_name

# Function to get access_token for yooz user
def get_token():
    url = "https://eu1.getyooz.com/auth/realms/yooz/protocol/openid-connect/token"
    client_id = 'yooz-public-api'
    username = 'support%40sixsevens.co.uk'
    password = 'REDACTED-ROTATE-ME'

    payload=F'grant_type=password&client_id={client_id}&username={username}&password={password}'
    headers = {
    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    }

    response = requests.request("POST", url, headers=headers, data=payload)

    access_token = json.loads(response.text)['access_token']

    return access_token

# Function to send file to import in yooz
def send_file(access_token, path_to_file, org_unit_code):
    url = F"https://eu1.getyooz.com/yooz/v2/api/orgUnits/{org_unit_code}/importPurchaseOrders"

    payload={}
    files=[
    ('file',(path_to_file,open(path_to_file,'rb'),'text/csv'))
    ]
    headers = {
    'applicationid': 'b0281c57-e1ab-4aec-9399-6b5806a9c49d',
    'Authorization': F'Bearer {access_token}'
    }

    response = requests.request("POST", url, headers=headers, data=payload, files=files)

    return response.text


# Function to convert csv to txt
def csv_to_txt(path_to_file):
    with open(path_to_file, "r") as f_csv:
        text = ''.join([i for i in f_csv]) 

    prefix = path_to_file.split('.')[0]
    txt_file_name = F'{prefix}.txt'

    with open(txt_file_name, 'w') as f:
        f.write(text)
    
    return txt_file_name

select a.src_key, b.mm_code as product_code, b.yooz_code as account_code from sixsevens_datavault.chikn.sat_inventoryitems a
left join (select * from SIXSEVENS_STAGE1.CHIKN.MARKETMAN_YOOZ_MAPS where map_type = 'PRODUCT-ACCOUNT_CODE') b 
on 
(
    CASE 
  		WHEN nvl(ltrim(rtrim(a.product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(a.src_key))) = '' THEN concat('PC_',ltrim(rtrim(a.src_key)))
  		ELSE CONCAT('PC_',nvl(ltrim(rtrim(a.product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(a.src_key))))
  	END = b.mm_code 

    or

    CASE 
  		WHEN nvl(ltrim(rtrim(a.product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(a.src_key))) = '' THEN CONCAT('PC_',ltrim(rtrim(a.src_key)))
  		ELSE CONCAT('PC_',nvl(ltrim(rtrim(a.product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(a.src_key))) || '_' || ltrim(rtrim(a.src_key)))
  	END = b.mm_code 
)
and a.src = 'MARKETMAN'

select 
        concat('PC_',replace(product_code,',',';')) as product_code,
        replace(item_name,',',';') as item_name,
        replace(category_name,',',';') as category_name,
        replace(vendor_name,',',';') as vendor_name,

    (
      select

                  ELSE nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key)))

                       ltrim(rtrim(item_name)) as item_name,

                                                              ELSE nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key))) 
                                                          END not in
      (
          select product_code from
          (
              select

                      CASE 
                          WHEN nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key))) = '' THEN ltrim(rtrim(src_key))
                          ELSE nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key)))

                               ltrim(rtrim(vendor_name)) 
              from sixsevens_datavault.chikn.sat_inventoryitems
          ) group by product_code having count(*) > 1
      )

      UNION

      select
          distinct 
              CASE 
                  WHEN nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key))) = '' THEN ltrim(rtrim(src_key))
                  ELSE nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key))) || '_' || ltrim(rtrim(src_key))
              END as product_code, 
                       ltrim(rtrim(item_name)) as item_name, 
                       ltrim(rtrim(category_name)) as category_name, 
                       ltrim(rtrim(vendor_name)) as vendor_name,
                       null as account_code
      from sixsevens_datavault.chikn.sat_inventoryitems where CASE 
                                                                  WHEN nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key))) = '' THEN ltrim(rtrim(src_key))
                                                                  ELSE nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key))) 
                                                              END in
      (
          select product_code from
          (
              select 
                  distinct 
                      CASE 
                          WHEN nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key))) = '' THEN ltrim(rtrim(src_key))
                          ELSE nvl(ltrim(rtrim(product_code)), ltrim(rtrim(src_key)))
                      END as product_code, 
                               ltrim(rtrim(item_name)), 
                               ltrim(rtrim(category_name)), 
                               ltrim(rtrim(vendor_name))
              from sixsevens_datavault.chikn.sat_inventoryitems
          ) group by product_code having count(*) > 1
      )
    )
